{{Quote|Is that so difficult to believe, Captain Solo? Yes, we have destroyed the other suspects: Hondo Bador, Cabot Lom, Nevid d'Hon, Berille Ada&mdash;anyone Mama might have angered by helping you.|Craitheus Qreph|<ref name="C">[[Crucible (novel)|''Crucible'']]</ref>}}
'''Nevid d'Hon''' was an [[Avogwi]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] outfitter who worked on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Mama (information broker)|Mama]] suggested d'Hon to [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] as a possible source of information regarding the kidnapping of [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Alfreda Goot]].<ref name="SL" />

d'Hon was destroyed by the [[Columi/Legends|Columi]] brothers, [[Craitheus Qreph|Craitheus]] and [[Marvid Qreph]] as revenge for the shooting of [[Mama (information broker)|their mother]]. They did not know if d'Hon had perpetrated the act. Believing that it was possible that d'Hon had killed Mama due to her association with Han Solo, the Qreph brothers crushed d'Hon by destroying his life and personal relationships to make sure that their mother had been avenged.<ref name="C" />
